model_scope.device: 2D n-IGZO electron-only drift-diffusion teaching model with the T02-A enabled symmetric dual-gate stack
model_scope.purpose: Run the minimum literature-constrained bottom-interface D_it transfer sensitivity after the separate equation smoke has passed.
fixed_variables: top gate is the primary swept gate and bottom gate is fixed at 0 V
channel length = 10 um and width = 60 um
top and bottom physical Al2O3 thickness = 30 nm
top and bottom dielectric relative permittivity = 6.8
source voltage = 0 V and drain voltage = 0.01 V
no bulk tail/deep traps, recombination, dynamic capture-emission, ferroelectric polarization, or non-ideal contacts
prohibited_work: bulk N_tail or N_deep trap scan
dynamic trapping, hysteresis, bias-stress, or reliability claims
physical Ion/Ioff, measured D_it, calibrated SS, or process-prediction claims
compact-model, SPICE, circuit, layout, or HZO work

directional_diagnostics.interpretation: Recorded diagnostics are not completion gates; contrary trends remain reportable results.

evidence_boundary_remains_interface_only.detail: After contract, simulation, and independent persisted-evidence checks pass, the three literature-constrained bottom-interface D_it inputs have completed a controlled transfer sensitivity in the frozen teaching model, with VTH, SS, Ioff, and gm reported only as numerical proxies.

evidence_boundary.allowed_claim: After contract, simulation, and independent persisted-evidence checks pass, the three literature-constrained bottom-interface D_it inputs have completed a controlled transfer sensitivity in the frozen teaching model, with VTH, SS, Ioff, and gm reported only as numerical proxies.
prohibited_claims: measured or fitted project D_it, calibrated SS, physical Ion/Ioff, mobility, or process prediction
energy-resolved interface-state distribution, dynamic capture-emission, hysteresis, bias-stress, reliability, or border-trap validation
bulk N_tail or N_deep trap evidence or complete P2 trap group
both-interface trap validation or complete T03 five-group sensitivity
compact-model, circuit, layout, or HZO evidence
evidence_boundary.next_gate: Only a passed formal scan plus independent check completes the interface-D_it substage and permits a separate T03-P2-BULK-TRAPS contract; P3, P5, SPICE, and layout remain closed.
